svg.text: Drive shaft: -y end 95 long beyond the bearing, key 6 x 6 x 30 for the hollow-shaft gearmotor (P1-420). Tail: 8 beyond the bearings both ends.
H3: M10 x 60 hex screw + 2 nuts through the lug; pushes the tail bearing flange; lock with the nut.
FRP RAIL 204 x 2 (1:5), PULTRUDED RECT TUBE 38.1 x 19.05 x 3.2 [1-1/2 x 3/4 x 1/8 in], ON EDGE
9 x Ø5.5 down through the top wall at 124 pitch for nylon screws to the bed; 2 x Ø5.5 across each end for the clips (nylon, H5).
Cut with a diamond blade, seal the cut ends with resin; no metal fasteners.
Bend 90° at the line (IR 4): short leg is the shelf under the rail; 2 x Ø6.6 to the plate (H4), 2 x Ø5.5 to the rail (nylon).
Ø5.5 c'sunk 90° from the top for nylon flat-head M5 (flush, under the belt); ends chamfered 3 x 30° so the belt cannot catch.
Infeed pair 280 long, outfeed pair 70 long (stop at the reject); ends radiused R20 at the infeed; 2 x M5 tapped per bracket.
SLOT 5.5 x -4: S / J guide positions; 2 x Ø5.5 in the leg to the plate G holes
